title: mbox: mbox_send_ihave maps 436/437 to Accepted (via default match arm) — transfer failure counted as imported
description: mbox.rs mbox_send_ihave() final match block: match code { 235 => IhaveSendResult::Accepted, _ => { info!(...); IhaveSendResult::Failed } }. So 436 (try again later) and 437 (article rejected) both map to Failed. Compare with ihave_push.rs where 436|437 => Rejected. Neither is wrong per se for summary purposes — but the real problem is that mbox.rs run_mbox_import() at lines 243-252 maps both Accepted AND Duplicate to summary.imported += 1. If a 435 Duplicate comes back it is counted as successfully imported, which is harmless but misleading. More critically: a 436 comes back as IhaveSendResult::Failed which increments summary.failed, but the session connection is still alive and a subsequent IHAVE can be sent. The connection is not closed on 436. This is a correctness issue when the remote is backpressuring — the import continues hammering a congested daemon.
